problem: No pipeline stages exist. Need Stage 1 (Ingest: parse CRBundle artifacts into structured IngestOutput) and Stage 2 (Normalize: field mapping, enum standardization, derived fields is_customer_facing and affected_tier). Must handle partial bundles (null artifacts pass through as None).
proposed_solution: Stage 1 at src/cr_analyzer/stages/ingest.py: accepts CRBundle, parses JSON as-is, extracts Markdown structure (sections, steps, service_refs, commands), produces IngestOutput. Stage 2 at src/cr_analyzer/stages/normalize.py: accepts IngestOutput, standardizes enums, derives is_customer_facing from CMDB tier, derives affected_tier, produces NormalizeOutput. Both handle null artifacts gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Stage 1 Ingest at src/cr_analyzer/stages/ingest.py: accepts CRBundle → returns IngestOutput
Ingest parses JSON artifacts as-is (cmdb, sla, schedule, incidents, pr_flags pass through)
Ingest extracts Markdown structure from runbook/rollback: sections (headings), steps (numbered items), service_refs (backtick names), commands (code blocks)
Ingest handles null artifacts: runbook=None → IngestOutput.runbook=None (no crash)
Stage 2 Normalize at src/cr_analyzer/stages/normalize.py: accepts IngestOutput → returns NormalizeOutput
Normalize standardizes change type to ChangeType enum, risk_category to RiskCategory enum
Normalize derives is_customer_facing from CMDB tier (tier 1-2 = True; no CMDB → False)
Normalize derives affected_tier as min tier across affected services in CMDB (no CMDB → 4)
Both stages produce valid Pydantic model outputs (model_validate on output succeeds)
Works on cr-001 full fixture: all fields preserved through ingest→normalize
Works on minimal/BPI-shaped partial bundle: nullable fields remain None, no crashes
Stage outputs serializable to JSON via model_dump_json() for disk checkpoints
pytest tests: cr-001 roundtrip, minimal bundle, BPI-shaped bundle
edge_cases: CRBundle with empty string runbook (not None but '') produces ParsedMarkdown with empty lists
CRBundle with no CMDB → is_customer_facing=False, affected_tier=4
